thesis: Ali from Cairo changes lethal damage into survival at one life, creating a fragile but memorable shield that asks whether the opponent can remove the creature before finishing the game.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: Damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead.
canonicalIdentity.identityNotes: Original Arabian Nights 1993-12-17 credited to Mark Poole; printing ID remains from accepted snapshot. Modern Oracle text is not misidentified as original printed wording. Verified focused mechanics source: https://mtg.wtf/card/arn/36/Ali-from-Cairo

originalContext.designPurpose: Ali from Cairo does not prevent combat damage. Its unusual replacement effect prevents damage from reducing its controller's life total below one, while non-damage life loss remains lethal.
